decisions.reason: Explicit local Docker integration checks cover installation, update, artifact identity rejection and restoration after a failed promotion; they run separately from ordinary PR checks.
PR and main CI run the admission tests for the new exact-revision local delivery boundary.
Local CD adds a negative CI-admission scenario, exact-revision artifact checks and HTTP candidate validation. Cloud deployment retains its manual identity boundary.
